## Findings
- claim-1: Assume the integral \(q^r\)-box/Schur/Pieri presentation, with \(q=i+p\), \(r=j+c\), \(i,j\ge2\), \(p,c\ge1\), \(\min(p,c)=1\), and \(d=ij\). The eight lower-degree named slots are \[ x_0=s_{i^j},\quad x_1=s_{(i+1,i^{j-1})},\quad y_1=s_{(i^j,1)}, \] \[ \gamma,\quad x_2=s_{((i+1)^2,i^{j-2})},\quad z=s_{(i+1,i^{j-1},1)},\quad y_2=s_{(i^j,2)},\quad\theta, \] where \(\deg x_0=d\), \(\deg x_1=\deg y_1=d+1\), and every remaining nonzero slot has degree \(d+2\). Here \(i^0\) is omitted.
- claim-2: The conditional definitions, including both boundary cases, are \[ \gamma= \begin{cases} s_{(i+2,i^{j-1})},&p\ge2,\\ 0,&p=1, \end{cases} \qquad \theta= \begin{cases} s_{(i^j,1,1)},&c\ge2,\\ 0,&c=1. \end{cases} \] Indeed, \(s_{(i+2,i^{j-1})}\) lies in the \(q^r\)-box exactly when \(i+2\le q=i+p\), equivalently \(p\ge2\); and \(s_{(i^j,1,1)}\) lies in that box exactly when \(j+2\le r=j+c\), equivalently \(c\ge2\). Since \(\min(p,c)=1\), the allowed cases are \((p,c)=(1,1)\), \(p=1,c\ge2\), or \(p\ge2,c=1\); hence \(\gamma\) and \(\theta\) are never simultaneously nonzero.
- claim-3: With these definitions, the lower-degree Pieri equalities are unambiguous: \[ h_1x_0=x_1+y_1,\qquad h_2x_0=\gamma+z+y_2, \] \[ h_1x_1=\gamma+x_2+z,\qquad h_1y_1=z+y_2+\theta. \] Each follows by adding respectively one box or a horizontal two-strip; a term outside the \(q^r\)-box is precisely replaced by \(0\) through the preceding conditional definitions.
- claim-4: The requested standalone-restatement certificate is established, conditional only on the stipulated integral box/Schur/Pieri presentation. No parent-theorem conclusion is made.
## Strategy
Assume a unital graded integral Schur/Pieri ring \(A\) with
\[
1=s_{\varnothing},\qquad
A=\bigoplus_{\lambda\subseteq q^r}\mathbb Zs_\lambda,\qquad
\deg s_\lambda=|\lambda|,
\]
where \(\lambda\subseteq q^r\) means \(\ell(\lambda)\le r\) and
\(\lambda_1\le q\). Set \(s_\lambda=0\) when \(\lambda\not\subseteq q^r\),
and stipulate integral Pieri multiplication
\[
h_k s_\lambda=\sum_{\substack{\mu\supseteq\lambda\\
\mu/\lambda\text{ a horizontal }k\text{-strip}}}s_\mu,
\qquad h_1=s_{(1)},\quad h_2=s_{(2)},
\]
with out-of-box summands zero.

Let
\[
q=i+p,\quad r=j+c,\quad i,j\ge2,\quad p,c\ge1,\quad \min(p,c)=1,
\quad d=ij.
\]
The eight named slots are
\[
x_0=s_{i^j},\quad x_1=s_{(i+1,i^{j-1})},\quad
y_1=s_{(i^j,1)},
\]
\[
\gamma,\quad x_2=s_{((i+1)^2,i^{j-2})},\quad
z=s_{(i+1,i^{j-1},1)},\quad
y_2=s_{(i^j,2)},\quad\theta,
\]
where \(i^0\) is omitted, and
\[
\gamma=
\begin{cases}
s_{(i+2,i^{j-1})},&p\ge2,\\
0,&p=1,
\end{cases}
\qquad
\theta=
\begin{cases}
s_{(i^j,1,1)},&c\ge2,\\
0,&c=1.
\end{cases}
\]
Here \(0\) is the zero class of \(A\), so \(\gamma,\theta\) are named
slots even on their vanishing boundaries. Their degrees are
\[
\deg x_0=d,\qquad \deg x_1=\deg y_1=d+1,
\]
and every nonzero degree-\(d+2\) slot has degree \(d+2\).

Box membership is explicit: \(x_0,x_1,y_1,x_2,z,y_2\) lie in \(q^r\)
because their widths are at most \(i+1\le i+p=q\) and their lengths are
at most \(j+1\le j+c=r\). Also,
\[
(i+2,i^{j-1})\subseteq q^r\iff i+2\le i+p\iff p\ge2,
\]
and
\[
(i^j,1,1)\subseteq q^r\iff j+2\le j+c\iff c\ge2.
\]
Thus the exhaustive cases are
\[
(p,c)=(1,1),\qquad p=1,\ c\ge2,\qquad p\ge2,\ c=1,
\]
and \(\gamma,\theta\) are never simultaneously nonzero.

The complete Pieri extensions are:
\[
i^j \xrightarrow{\text{one box}}
(i+1,i^{j-1}),\ (i^j,1),
\]
\[
i^j \xrightarrow{\text{horizontal two-strip}}
(i+2,i^{j-1}),\ (i+1,i^{j-1},1),\ (i^j,2),
\]
\[
(i+1,i^{j-1})\xrightarrow{\text{one box}}
(i+2,i^{j-1}),\ ((i+1)^2,i^{j-2}),\
(i+1,i^{j-1},1),
\]
\[
(i^j,1)\xrightarrow{\text{one box}}
(i+1,i^{j-1},1),\ (i^j,2),\ (i^j,1,1).
\]
There are no other extensions: equal-length rows permit extension only
at the first row of a constant block, and a new row is the sole other
one-box possibility; the listed horizontal two-strips are likewise all
ways to add two boxes in distinct columns.

Consequently, with the conditional zero conventions,
\[
h_1x_0=x_1+y_1,\qquad h_2x_0=\gamma+z+y_2,
\]
\[
h_1x_1=\gamma+x_2+z,\qquad h_1y_1=z+y_2+\theta.
\]
This establishes the conditional standalone-restatement certificate only.

## Gaps
The ambient integral box/Schur/Pieri presentation is stipulated here, not
independently proved or externally grounded. No parent-theorem conclusion
is made.

## Next
